name: PrimObject::Random (SimAntics opcode 0x08)
notes: handler(frame, param) ret 8, always returns 1 or throws a short (0x14 store out of range, 0x13 no destination). Operand reader = slot 7 of the subobject at +4 (7 stack args, ret 0x1c), generator = slot 55 of the object at +0x48 then cRZRandom::RandomUint32Uniform(int bound sign-extended) (ours, verified). Test world carries recording fakes for both slots; compares thrown code, full call trace (incl. trailing zero args), the stored short/float, the generator state. 20,000 seeds (bounds 0, negative, 32767, -32768; full/tight/inverted ranges; float and short destinations; seeds incl. edges). The reader's return for the destination call and the upper half of the bound's eax are randomised: ignored/ax-only. Mutants killed (7): swapped scope/id on the destination read; bound-0 range error dropped; float conversion signed; error code 0x13 changed to 0x14; bound zero-extended; short store check dropped; bound read given the destination arguments. Float local: the original leaves it unset until the reader writes it (the reader zeroes it first); ours starts it null.

name: PrimObject::Prim07 (SimAntics opcode 0x07)
notes: handler ret 8, returns 1 or throws 0x15 (frame lookup gave null) / 3 (bad selector, bad mode). Calls slot 26 of the object at +0x40 first always, then (selector 1) the frame's slot 12 (word, sign-extended) and the lookup object's slot 29. Differential: 20,000 seeds against recording fakes, thrown code and call trace compared. Mutants killed: error code 0x15, mode range (2 dropped), frame word zero-extended. Survivors (equivalent): mode compared unsigned (only 0, 1, 2 pass either way), and dropping the final null check on the result (unreachable: the result is this or a checked non-null object).

name: PrimObject::Prim0F (SimAntics opcode 0x0f)
notes: handler ret 8, returns 1 or throws 0x3e when bit 0 of param byte +8 is clear and the operand (scope +6, id +4) reads nonzero. The original calls 0x57e910 (that bit; verified elsewhere) and ours writes the one-line test out. Differential: 20,000 seeds. Mutants killed: flag bit, error code, 8-bit value.
